# aria-sort: no browser e2e, and every idle header updates on each sort

> **Correction, 2026-10-20 ~13:05Z.** The first version of this ticket called the comment in `src/table/header/Button.mjs` `removeSortingCss()` false. It is correct: writing back unchanged classes runs no `afterSetCls()` and no update. My probe started from headers whose `isSorted: null` had never run `afterSetIsSorted()`, so they were not hidden yet. The steady-state measurement below replaces it, and the defect is the opposite one.

## Context

#19908 (merged 2026-10-20, resolves #19886) gives the grid and table header buttons `aria-sort`. I was reviewing it when it merged. Two findings from that review still hold on `dev`:

1. **Nothing in the suite reads `aria-sort` off a rendered header.** `HeaderButtonSortable.spec.mjs` reads vdom. The DOM reads in the PR body were a manual probe. A grid change needs a browser e2e that fails on the base and passes with the fix; #19777 waited for one.
2. **Every idle header now updates on every sort.** Both `removeSortingCss()` methods clear `aria-sort` and update unconditionally: the grid through `changeVdomRootKey()`, the table through an explicit `me.update()`. The container calls `removeSortingCss()` on every header except the sorted one. Before #19908, an already-hidden header wrote back the same classes and did not update.

## The Problem

I measured the steady state with a unit probe. There are five headers. The first sort, on header 0, leaves headers 1–4 hidden. The second sort, on header 1, then runs `removeSortingCss()` on the other four, counting calls per header:

| source | `update()`: header 0 (loses its sort) | `update()`: headers 2–4 (already hidden) |
|---|---|---|
| before #19908 (`617684fb84`) | 1 | 0 |
| `dev` with #19908 (`9771bebcb8`) | 2 | 1 each |

The grid and table counts are identical. In both sources `afterSetCls` runs once for header 0 and never for headers 2–4.

A sort on a grid with N columns used to update one header. It now updates N−1 headers, N−2 of which carry no `aria-sort` and render nothing new. I did not measure what the extra calls cost in the browser. This ticket claims only the call count.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/component/Base.mjs`: `changeVdomRootKey()` always calls `me.update()`. `afterSetCls()` runs only when the classes change, because the generated setter skips `afterSet` when `config.set()` finds the value equal (`src/Neo.mjs`).
- `src/grid/Container.mjs` and `src/table/Container.mjs` `removeSortingCss(dataField)` call the header's `removeSortingCss()` on every header except the sorted one, on every sort.
- Only the header that loses its sort carries `aria-sort`. Its classes usually change too (`neo-sort-hidden` is added), but not for a sorted header that `sortable: false` hid afterwards. That is why the clear needs its own update when there is something to clear, and only then.
- The grid's menu wrap (`wrapColumnMenuRoot()`) keeps the original root as `cn[0]`, so `getVdomRoot()` stays the columnheader node.
- E2E homes:
  - `test/playwright/e2e/grid/IssuesShowcase.spec.mjs` opens `examples/grid/issues` on a stubbed snapshot, with `#` sorted descending at start.
  - `examples/table/container` has no spec yet. The table specs live in `test/playwright/e2e/table/`.

## The Fix

1. `src/grid/header/Button.mjs` `removeSortingCss()`: call `changeVdomRootKey('aria-sort', null)` only when `getVdomRoot()` carries `aria-sort`.
2. `src/table/header/Button.mjs` `removeSortingCss()`: delete and `update()` only when the `<th>` carries `aria-sort`, and keep the comment's reason.
3. E2E: read `aria-sort` off the rendered headers, sort by clicking a header, then read again:
   - the grid: `#` and Title in `IssuesShowcase.spec.mjs`;
   - the table: Firstname and Lastname on `examples/table/container`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: A grid e2e asserts that the sorted header carries `aria-sort` (`descending` at start, `ascending` after the click) and that the other headers carry none. It fails with both header files at `9771bebcb8^` and passes on `dev`.
- [ ] AC-2: A table e2e does the same on `examples/table/container`.
- [ ] AC-3: In the steady state, a sort updates no header that carries no `aria-sort`. A unit arm in `HeaderButtonSortable.spec.mjs` asserts this for both buttons. It fails at `9771bebcb8`, and the spec stays green.

## Out of Scope

- `afterSetIsSorted()`'s own write. It touches one header per sort, which already updates for its class change.
- Whether `changeVdomRootKey()` should skip `update()` when nothing changed. That is engine-wide.
- `Container#removeSortingCss()` walking every header on every sort (it predates #19908).
- How a real screen reader announces it (#19908's post-merge validation).
